title: Examining Social, Emotional, and Cognitive Functioning in People With Fragile X and Down Syndromes
brief_summary: By testing physiological responses to anxiety in people with nervous system developmental disorders, this study will identify specific physiological characteristics associated with response to anxiety treatments.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Fragile X premutation or fragile X syndrome, measured by DNA testing; Down syndrome, confirmed by chromosomal analysis; or normally developing control
* Normal hearing
study_population: Individuals with fragile X syndrome, Down syndrome, the fragile X premutation, and normal development
